scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm synth
scripts.format: biome format --write . && uv run --project src/functions/app --frozen ruff format src/functions/app
scripts.lint: biome check . && uv run --project src/functions/app --frozen ruff check src/functions/app && uv run --project src/functions/app --frozen ruff format --check src/functions/app
scripts.lint:fix: biome check --write . && uv run --project src/functions/app --frozen ruff check --fix src/functions/app
